## Pull request overview

This PR updates project documentation and roadmap status to reflect completion of several roadmap items, including new documentation for the Feed/Chatter (plugin-detail) package and updated milestone/status metadata.

**Changes:**
- Added new MDX documentation page for the Feed & Chatter system (`plugin-detail`).
- Registered the new plugin doc page in the plugins docs navigation (`meta.json`).
- Updated `ROADMAP.md` statuses/metrics (marking items complete, refreshing dates and success metrics).

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `content/docs/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx` | Adds documentation for Feed/Chatter components, usage, and Console integration examples. |
| `content/docs/plugins/meta.json` | Adds `plugin-detail` to the plugins docs sidebar ordering. |
| `ROADMAP.md` | Marks roadmap items complete and refreshes “success metrics” and priorities. |

This note is technically inaccurate: React dependency arrays use `Object.is` on each dependency, not “shallow equality”. Depending on the whole `activeView` object only works if updates always replace it with a new object reference when any sub-property changes; otherwise hooks will not re-run. Please rephrase to reflect reference equality semantics (and/or note the requirement that `activeView` must be immutable).
```suggestion
- [x] Audit all `useMemo`/`useEffect` dependency arrays in `plugin-view/ObjectView.tsx` for missing `activeView` sub-properties — all hooks correctly depend on the whole `activeView` object reference; because React compares dependencies by reference with `Object.is`, this relies on `activeView` being updated immutably (new object reference whenever any sub-property changes)
```

The roadmap now reports updated build/test/storybook metrics (e.g., “43/43 pass”, “6,700+” tests), but the PR description indicates the full test run hasn’t been completed yet. Please run the full CI-equivalent checks (at least `pnpm test` / `pnpm build`, and update these numbers based on the actual output) or mark these metrics as unverified until the run is done.

`InteractiveDemo` is imported at the MDX top-level but never used in this document. Please remove the unused import (or add an actual InteractiveDemo section) to avoid unused-import warnings and keep the docs consistent with other plugin pages.
